description: Deciding-function calibration: positives, negatives and support. Named scalar calibration summaries, with exact counts and original/equal law-aware decisions. A successful calibration is not a successful trained model. Unsupported/empty nulls do not pass; the r10 trained positive is a fixed-endpoint condition. Floors and exact-oracle ceilings are retained in the named condition rows. Per-presentation and per-slot arrays remain in the hash-verified full calibration records; slot floors are in the probe table. Five significant digits for continuous values. Analytical reduction only; exact per-cell and per-update rows remain released. Detailed records: paper/data/release/appendix_C_calibration.json.gz (schema and SHA-256 in release/index.json).
